title: 安全使用离心机
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/01_Laboratory Safety Using a Centrifuge.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/01_Laboratory Safety Using a Centrifuge/src.py

points.K6: 吊篮和管子：匹配、干燥、清洁
points.K8: 放在稳固水平的台面上

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台落地式离心机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floor-standing centrifuge in a lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天学习怎样安全使用离心机。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一支离心管，站在离心机前犹豫
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a single centrifuge tube and hesitates in front of an open benchtop centrifuge.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次用离心机，有点发愁。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，向阿杰招手示意
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over to the young male student and gestures for him to watch.
shots.narration: 小研说：几个要点，记住就好。

shots.scene: 小研打开落地式离心机盖，俯身看向里面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and glasses opens the lid of a floor-standing centrifuge and leans in.
shots.narration: 离心机靠高速旋转产生离心力。

shots.scene: 转子高速旋转示意，周围有黄色弧形箭头
shots.prompt_en: A top-down view of a spinning rotor with bright yellow curved arrows circling around it. No people.
shots.narration: 把管里的东西按密度分开。

shots.scene: 一支分层的样品管：下层深红、上层淡黄
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds up a centrifuge tube with a dark red layer at the bottom and a pale yellow layer on top.
shots.narration: 密度大的沉底，密度小的在上层。

shots.scene: 迷你、台式、落地式离心机图标由小到大排开
shots.prompt_en: Three centrifuge icons in a row from small to large: a mini centrifuge, a benchtop centrifuge and a floor-standing centrifuge. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机有大有小，尺寸很多。

shots.scene: 一台老式台式离心机，面板贴着空白便签
shots.prompt_en: An older benchtop centrifuge with a blank yellow sticky note on its control panel. No people.
shots.narration: 老式的、冷冻的，各有用途。

shots.scene: 三张图标卡：转速表、离心管、实验室平面
shots.prompt_en: Three icon cards: a speed gauge, a centrifuge tube with a volume mark, and a simple lab floor plan. No people.
shots.narration: 按转速、管子大小、样品量和空间选。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在穿戴整齐的小研旁边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the female graduate student, who wears a lab coat, long pants, closed shoes, safety glasses and gloves.
shots.narration: 装载离心机前，先记住几件事。

shots.scene: 五个防护图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a lab coat, long pants, a fully enclosed shoe, safety glasses and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服、长裤、全包鞋、安全眼镜、手套。

shots.scene: 小研戴紫色手套，在天平上逐支称量离心管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing purple gloves weighs centrifuge tubes one by one on an electronic balance.
shots.narration: 每支管子称一称，重量要相当。

shots.scene: 转子俯视图，两支管子放在正对面
shots.prompt_en: A top-view icon of a rotor with two tubes placed directly opposite each other, linked by a dotted line, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 把它们放在转子正对面的位置。

shots.scene: 小研往空管里加水，与阿杰的样品管并排
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills an empty tube with water next to the young male student's sample tube.
shots.narration: 只有一管样品，就做一支配平管。

shots.scene: 两支管子放在天平两侧，天平持平
shots.prompt_en: Two tubes on the two pans of a balance scale, perfectly level, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这样负载才平衡。

shots.section_title: 吊篮和管子：匹配、干燥、清洁
shots.scene: 吊篮和离心管嵌合的图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a centrifuge tube fitting snugly into a swing bucket, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 吊篮和管子要安装匹配。
overlay: 吊篮和管子：匹配、干燥、清洁

shots.section_title: 吊篮和管子：匹配、干燥、清洁
shots.scene: 小研俯身把吊篮放进落地式离心机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leans over and places dry clean swing buckets into a floor-standing centrifuge.
shots.narration: 还要干燥、清洁。

shots.scene: 小研盖上离心机盖，按下锁扣
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the centrifuge lid and presses it down until the latch clicks.
shots.narration: 盖好机盖并固定住。

shots.section_title: 放在稳固水平的台面上
shots.scene: 离心机放在平稳的台面上，旁边有水平仪
shots.prompt_en: A benchtop centrifuge sits on a solid lab bench with a bubble level beside it showing level. No people.
shots.narration: 启动前，确认台面稳固、水平。
overlay: 放在稳固水平的台面上

shots.scene: 离心机抖动的示意，周围有震动线
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge with vibration lines around it shakes and wobbles. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机晃动、摇摆怎么办？

shots.scene: 小研伸手拔下墙上插座的电源插头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reaches to a wall outlet and pulls out the centrifuge power plug.
shots.narration: 立即停机，或者拔掉电源。

shots.scene: 电源插头已拔下，转子仍在转的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a centrifuge with its plug pulled out while the rotor inside still spins with curved arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 这只切断了转子的动力。

shots.scene: 旋转箭头逐渐变慢变短
shots.prompt_en: Curved spin arrows around a rotor icon get shorter and fainter, showing it slowing down. No people.
shots.narration: 转子还会转，靠摩擦慢慢停下。

shots.scene: 台式离心机空白屏幕旁，黄色警示条图标
shots.prompt_en: A benchtop centrifuge with a blank display and a yellow warning strip with a lid icon and a spinning arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 完全停止后，才能打开机盖。

shots.scene: 俯拍开盖后的离心腔，转子已停
shots.prompt_en: A top-down view into an open centrifuge chamber with a stopped rotor holding yellow adapters. No people.
shots.narration: 晃动，通常是转子没有配平。

shots.scene: 损坏的机器和受伤的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cracked centrifuge and two person pictograms with bandages. No people.
shots.narration: 会严重损坏设备，伤到身边的人。

shots.scene: 小研从离心机里取出吊篮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the swing buckets out of the stopped centrifuge.
shots.narration: 操作者和同事都可能受伤。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一张空白的离心机资料单，上面有二维码图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank centrifuge fact sheet with a QR code icon on it.
shots.narration: 想了解更多，看离心机资料单。

shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the safety administrator a question in the lab office.
shots.narration: 有疑问，联系本单位安全部门。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现防护、天平、锁盖图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of safety glasses, a balance scale and a locked lid.
shots.narration: 穿好防护，称重配平，盖好机盖。

shots.scene: 水平仪、插头、停转转子三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a bubble level, a power plug and a stopped rotor. No people.
shots.narration: 台面平稳，晃动停机，停稳再开。

shots.scene: 欣欣在离心机旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a centrifuge with its lid closed.
shots.narration: 平稳离心，安全实验，下次见！
